decisions.statement: A key is read as the type that key is asked for or as nothing.
A value naming a page by page type and slug is read here for its slug alone.
A key naming a page or a list of pages is read here as a list of slugs.
Which page type a value is, is read here under either key a value states it as.
One reader here answers empty text as empty text and another answers empty text as nothing.
Neither reader is exchanged for a module, because a module answers only one.
A key holding one record or a list of them is read here as a list of records.
A browser reaches this module and never the module loading a value from a file.
Nothing here imports a module node carries.

definition: what one key of a page's value has, read off a value already in hand
